_comment: Hand-checked fixes where WoW: Forever moved things. Each anchor must be a Forever source; see docs/locations.md for the evidence.

the-stockade.why: Forever re-framed the Stormwind City map, so the Classic entrance coordinates (Era frame) land at the city's west edge if read as live coordinates; converted to the live frame they come within ~30 yd. Warden Thelwater stands at the Stockade gate in the Forever database, beside the Forever meeting stone, so the gate itself is used.

stormwind-harbor.why: Both the Classic flight-point position and the NPC centre fall in the middle of the city; the Forever routing survey records the boat dock on the west-side piers.

steamwheedle-port.why: The Atlas position (51, 29) is Gadgetzan's flight point, not the port. Uses the Forever boat dock and the Forever port NPCs around it (Jabbey, Yeh'kinya, Prospector Ironboot) at ~(67.0, 23.9).
